column1: # Jev baseline: the floors `scripts/ci/jev-baseline.sh` holds TypeSafe Jev with KMP to,
# measured on the judged corpus against the recorded cassette. missing_* score kmp_curate's
# missing relations (found at all; typed as a reader accepts), distractors_rejected the pairs
# that share words without a relation, suspect_* the audit against planted bad and known good
# declarations, precheck_* the apply pre-write check, ask_* the rank of the answer in proof
# without and with re-ranking. A number may rise freely; lowering one is a reviewed change
# that says why, and a re-recorded cassette is one. `cases` is exact.
# wake_all_pages_* follow projection.next_action to the last page; before that fix the scorecard
# read a top-level next_action no wake carries, so "all pages" was only the first page and
# wake_all_pages_plain sat at the first-page 0.9333. Following the chain raised it to 1.0000.
# ask_*_plain are read with the anchored ask gate since it became the default (2026-09-26):
# a plain ask whose question names an identifier ranks the memories that name it, and
# ask_mrr_plain rose 0.1875 -> 0.2500, ask_top5_plain 0.2500 -> 0.3125. The re-ranked arms
# P9 (2026-09-27): write-relations and focused reviews read shortlisted partners, so the
# 318-fact case's focused requests are new; they were recorded into this cassette with the
# real Jev, nothing else re-recorded. Every floor holds unchanged; the margin gate (tau = 0)
# settles 2 of the 16 re-ranked asks without moving ask_*_rerank or ask_*_wide.
# P11 (2026-09-27): a path search with a goal asks about its corridor (at most 22 facts within
# four hops of either end, DESIGN L7) and offers each next step among at most 8 neighbours. Its
# new requests were recorded into this cassette with the real Jev (sample 1 of 3). The goal
# searches cost 3.4k Jev tokens on average instead of 8.2k (g30 -> g32: 22.4k -> 3.5k) and find
# the same paths (path_found_with_jev 0.8 in all three samples). proposed_hops_right lowers from
# 0.9500 to 0.9411 for one reason: in two samples of three the corridor judged g31 at 0.49,
# under the 0.5 line, so g30 -> g32 returns one path instead of two and its three right hops
# leave the count (16/17 instead of 19/20). The one wrong hop is the same b02 -> b03 as before.
# Reviewed change (2026-09-28): the corridor is ON by default by decision of the maintainer,
# who accepted that cost, so proposed_hops_right is gated at 0.9411 (was 0.9500 while the
# corridor was opt-in) and the informative proposed_hops_right_corridor_info row is gone.
# KMP_EVAL_PATHS_CORRIDOR=off still measures the previous filter (0.9500) for reference.
